collector_notes: Assigned hostile trait is the 2026 RENAME (Sequent Scientific Ltd / SEQUENT -> Viyash Scientific Ltd / VIYASH, effective 2026-01-23). Confirmed from the primary source (NSE circular NSE/CML/72374) and from the company's own exchange filings, every one of which still carries the line 'Formerly known as Sequent Scientific Limited'. Two further traps surfaced that the manifest did not anticipate and that matter more for a data-trust diff than the rename itself: (a) a CONSOLIDATED-vs-STANDALONE gulf so wide the two screener.in pages for the same ISIN disagree on P/E by 2.6x (49.6 vs 129) and on revenue by 2.5x; (b) the FY25 merger of Viyash Life Sciences into the listed entity, which puts a step discontinuity in the middle of every annual and TTM series, so 'revenue growth' is +13.7% or +53.0% purely as a function of the window chosen. Five reachable sources quote five different TTM EPS (5.76 / 4.90 / 4.18 / 2.21 / 1.75) and four different P/E for the same security on the same date. bseindia.com returns HTTP 403 to automated fetch, but its announcement PDFs are reachable with a browser UA and redirect-following, which is how the primary filings below were obtained. WebSearch budget for the session was exhausted before this task began; all discovery was done with direct URL fetches plus a Bing results page.

consolidated_vs_standalone.value: AMBIGUOUS AND MATERIAL - consolidated is the correct default, and the gap is the largest single source of wrong numbers for this name.
consolidated_vs_standalone.detail: screener.in serves consolidated at /company/VIYASH/consolidated/ and standalone at /company/512529/. Same ISIN, same day, and they disagree on: P/E 49.6 vs 129; book value 66.6 vs 73.0; ROE 7.39% vs 3.43%; ROCE 13.4% vs 5.57%; TTM sales 3,575 vs 1,408 Cr; TTM net profit 267 vs 79 Cr; TTM EPS 5.76 vs 2.21; Jun-2026 quarter sales 946 vs 354 Cr. The standalone entity is roughly 40% of the group by revenue because the operating businesses (Alivira animal health, the Ireland/Italy subsidiaries, the merged Viyash entities) sit below the listed company. A terminal that resolves BSE code 512529 to the standalone page and NSE symbol VIYASH to the consolidated page will show two different companies for the same security depending on which identifier the user typed.

traps: RENAME (assigned trait): SEQUENT -> VIYASH effective 2026-01-23. Every pre-2026 chart, filing, peer table, broker note and news article is filed under SEQUENT. SEQUENT resolves to nothing in the live NSE master (verified against today's EQUITY_L.csv, not just the repo's stale copy), so a user typing the name they have known for a decade gets a hard miss with no 'formerly known as' hint anywhere.
The ISIN did NOT change at the rename (INE807F01027). ISIN is therefore the only stable join key across the rename boundary - any history stitched on symbol alone will break at 2026-01-23.

MERGER DISCONTINUITY: Viyash Life Sciences was merged into the listed entity, landing in the Dec-2024 quarter. Consolidated sales step 369 -> 774 Cr QoQ and 1,370 -> 3,007 Cr YoY. Every CAGR, YoY and TTM computed across that boundary is a scope change reported as growth. The same event moved promoter holding 52.33% -> 61.41% in Dec 2025.
CONSOLIDATED vs STANDALONE: 2.5x on revenue, 2.6x on P/E, 3.4x on net profit. screener.in's own two pages for this ISIN disagree on every headline ratio.
TTM EPS spread of 3.3x across five sources (5.76 / 4.90 / 4.18 / 2.21 / 1.75) and P/E spread of 3.1x (41.24 / 49.6 / 51.16 / 59.78 / 129) on the same ISIN on the same date.
FACE VALUE IS 2 INR, not 10. Any source or pipeline that normalises per-share figures to a 10-rupee face value is off by 5x on EPS and book value.

screener.in's printed P/E does not equal its own price / its own TTM EPS (250 / 5.76 = 43.4 vs printed 49.6). The printed ratio uses an undisclosed profit basis. Do not assume a site's ratios are internally derivable.

TRADINGVIEW RANGE TRAP: TradingView's fetched page shows an all-time high (336.50, Jun 29 2021) and all-time low (42.65, Oct 9 2018) where a naive scraper expects a 52-week range. Real 52-week range is 298 / 178. Reading it wrong yields a 52-week low 4x below the actual one.

TRADINGVIEW STALE SHARE COUNT: prints 194.30 M shares outstanding, irreconcilable with its own market cap and price (implies 553.7 INR/share against a 249.65 quote). Actual count is ~435-441 M. Pre-merger figure never refreshed.

STALE IDENTITY ACROSS AGGREGATORS: Upstox still titles the page 'Sequent Scientific (VIYASH)'; screener.in's About paragraph still opens 'Sequent Scientific is India's leading animal health company'; TradingView still says 'veterinary pharmaceuticals and specialty chemicals' and 'headquartered in Mumbai'. The registered office is in fact Hyderabad, Telangana (CIN L99999TS1985PLC196357 - note the TS state code on a company incorporated in 1985 as a Maharashtra entity).

SECTOR IS UNRESOLVABLE: animal health (stockscans), generic pharma (screener, Upstox), 'Health Technology' (TradingView), or the company's own 'integrated API + human health + animal health + CDMO'. Post-merger it is genuinely no longer an animal-health pure play, so the aggregator taxonomies are describing a company that stopped existing in FY25.
EPS SIGN TRAP: Mar-2024 quarter shows net profit +1 Cr with EPS -0.04 (minority interest). Deriving EPS as net profit / shares gets the sign wrong.
PLEDGE ABSENT, NOT ZERO: no reachable source publishes a promoter-pledge percentage. Rendering a missing pledge field as 0% is a fabricated reassurance on a promoter-heavy (61.31%) mid-cap.

OPEN CORPORATE ACTION: the BioForLife Italia acquisition is approved but not completed (expected ~2026-11-08), and two ESOP allotments landed in the two weeks before collection. Share count and consolidation scope are both in motion, so per-share figures legitimately drift between any two collection dates.
DII DEFINITION SPLIT: screener's single 'DII 3.76%' is Upstox's 'Mutual Funds 2.93% + DII (Other) 0.83%'. A naive field-to-field diff reports a mismatch where the data agrees.
